headline: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited Signs MoU with Government of Rajasthan to Set Up HFO Manufacturing Plant
summary: Stallion India Fluorochemicals has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Government of Rajasthan to set up a hydrofluoroolefin manufacturing plant in the state.
why: Hydrofluoroolefins are low global warming potential refrigerants, and new plants add capacity in a segment shaped by environmental regulation on refrigerants.
